section_summary.extract_value: This Data Analyses section describes the statistical procedures used to examine associations between BMI, age, early memories of warmth and safeness (EMWSS), self-compassion (SC), body appreciation (BAS-2), and eating psychopathology (EDE-Q). The study employed Pearson correlations and path analyses using SPSS and AMOS software, with body appreciation assessed using the BAS-2 instrument. Path analyses examined mediator effects of self-compassion and body appreciation in the relationship between early memories of warmth and safeness and disordered eating attitudes and behaviors, controlling for BMI and age.
